brief:
Israeli occupation forces continued to violate the Gaza ceasefire agreement on Friday, Shehab Wire reported, conducting sustained military operations across the strip. The violations included artillery bombardment targeting scattered locations throughout Gaza, along with intensive ground-level escalation that persisted despite the truce framework.

The reported breaches add to an emerging pattern of ceasefire infractions since the agreement took effect. Israeli forces have maintained military pressure in multiple sectors of Gaza through bombardment and tactical operations that officials and witnesses say contravene the terms of the ceasefire accord.
